ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, approximately 1:18, with high-intensity pixels strictly clustered at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; the central ventral surface consists of a continuous low-intensity dark field with minimal interior pixel variance.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 125 degrees and a shallow depth of approximately 40 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (5-10 pixel peaks) distributed along the entire trailing edge; irregular topography is most pronounced on the inner margins of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the peduncle to the tips, terminating in sharp upward-tapering lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters aggregated at the lateral extremities consistent with barnacle growth; several isolated low-contrast circular clusters visible in the mid-lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified masses at the lateral tips; minor trailing edge irregularities indicating tissue degradation on the medial section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A primary vertical low-intensity shadow bisects the fluke from the median notch to the water surface line.
